title: Installation, Maintenance and Observation of the Instruments for Vibration Studies other than Earthquakes on Hydraulic Structures and Machines — Code of Practice
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard recommends instruments essential for observation of vibrations arising from hydraulic structures and machines. Vibration studies are conducted on hydraulic machines namely pumps, hydro-turbines, on civil structures namely dams, divide walls, bridges, power houses, foundations and on other parts namely gates, penstocks, trash-racks, etc. It further covers the details on installation of accelerometers and procedure for observations of the vibration with the help of associated instrumentation containing signal conditioner and signal processor. 1.2 Vibration due to earthquake is beyond the scope of this standard.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Method for Blast Vibration Monitoring - Guidelines

clause_3_terminology: Maintenance and Observation of the Instruments for Vibration Studies other than Earthquakes on Hydraulic Structures and Machines

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
